source_text: ὁ γάρ τοι λόγος καθάπερ τὸ κήρυγμα τὸ Ὀλυμπίασι καλεῖ μὲν τὸν βουλόμενον, στεφανοῖ δὲ τὸν δυνάμενον.
pass_a_gloss: For indeed the word, just-as the proclamation the at-Olympia, calls on-the-one-hand the one willing, but crowns the one being-able.
pass_b_english: For the Word, like the herald’s call at Olympia, calls whoever is willing, and crowns whoever is able.

choices.why: Keep source term concrete in Pass B.
